designer_summary: Sentry is within its isolated economic target; that reading is HIGH confidence. Guard isolated (direct) value is within target; total value including blocking is only HIGH after counterfactual/Shapley. Mixed-build counterfactuals were measured, so Guard indirect damage can be discussed. Meltdown underperformance is HIGH confidence: relative 0.06× and peak cell 20.0% of nominal. Normal is classifiable: competent loses, optimizer loses, defense margin 0.0. Recommended Meltdown parameters: { "flow_start_mass": 12.0, "damage_full_mass": 24.0, "pour_rate": 1.2, "lava_lifetime": 16.0 } (score 3.31). Catalog writes require an explicit apply step.
